text:
tom: heads-up: saw a subtle regression in canary for raven-ensemble-fallback. duplicate funcall actions for same request (two identical `create_ticket` actions) after fallback to int4 mirror.

asha: omg, any repro traces? that can be user-visible and bad.

canary-bot: deploy raven-ensemble-canary @ 1746008000 -> hostset d,e. last 30m: 1200 successes / 14 anomalies. anomaly ids: cnry-1746009881, cnry-1746010022.

liam: i pulled the raw trace for cnry-1746010022. sequence: primary model returned `{"action":"create_ticket","idempotency":"tok123","args":{...}}` then fallback emitted a second matching action but stripped the idempotency field due to a quant tokenization quirk — downstream executor treated it as new. sample: ```{"action":"create_ticket","args":{"title":"..."}}
```

renee: so the fault is not parse failure but a field drop during fallback output generation. how often?

ken: telemetry query `duplicate_action_rate by model,quant` shows: primary (fp16) baseline: 0.02%, ensemble-fallback-int4: 1.3% concentrated on short funcalls (<80 tokens) and on routes with `fallback_policy=mirror`.

marta: interesting. my hypothesis: quant model sometimes outputs compressed forms (omitting optional fields) and our call-rescue layer assumed missing `idempotency` -> new action instead of checking content fingerprint. fallback flow doesn't rehydrate idempotency.

asha: any quick mitigation? could we canonicalize action blobs before execution (hash args+action name) and dedupe by fingerprint for a short TTL?

liam: yes, we can compute action_fingerprint = sha256(action_name + json_canonicalize(args)) and check executor store for recent fingerprint within 5s. if present, drop duplicate. cheap and safe for immediate mitigation.

renee: agree as a short-term fix, but we must record telemetry when dedupe triggers so we can see how often fallback is stripping idempo. add tag `rescue=dedupe_fingerprint`.

ken: two cautions: 1) canonicalization must be stable (sort object keys, normalize whitespace, canonicalize numbers). 2) some actions intentionally produce identical payloads twice (e.g., multi-step ops) so we need a conservative TTL and an allowlist for idempotent endpoints.

marta: long-term fix: make fallback route preserve idempotency tokens or have model generation policy to prefer keeping explicit idempotency fields. we should also add canary tests that verify presence of contract-required fields after fallback. open QNT-1022 to track with quant team.

asha: additional observation: some duplicates also coincided with parse repairs (we apply sanitize_controlchars and surrogate repairs). repair path sometimes changes field order which affected naive string-hash dedupe in earlier PoC — need canonicalization as liam suggested.

liam: implementation plan: 1) executor dedupe by canonical fingerprint (5s TTL) + telemetry increment 2) call-rescue canonicalize util with strict JSON loading and JSON canonicalize serializer 3) feature-flag on for canary routes only for 24h 4) run golden action correctness check comparing pre-fallback expected actions vs post-fallback executed actions on 2k samples.

canary-bot: note: enabling feature flag on hostset `d,e` will roll to 20% of canary hosts. proceed?

renee: also add alert if `dedupe_fingerprint` >0.5% for 1h or if `fallback_missing_field_rate` >0.2%. we need a small dashboard tile showing `fallback_strip_fields` counts by field name.

marta: i'll add a unit test in kernel regression suite: run ensemble fallback scenarios with models that produce optional-field-omissions and ensure tokens don't get dropped. QNT-1022 assigned to quant infra.

asha: one more thing: for auditability we should mirror both original and dedup-decision events to archive (s3) with request_id so legal/cs can review if a dropped action caused issues. tag mirror files `duplicate_audit`.

liam: i'll draft PR for dedupe util + canonicalizer today. plan to opt-in on canary and run 24h. will attach sample reproducer and benchmark micro latency cost of fingerprint check (should be <0.2ms).

tom: thanks. action items: liam implement + PR, ken add alerts & dashboard panels, marta kernel test + QNT-1022, asha coordinate customer-facing messaging if we see user impact. i'll kick off soft-canary after PR lands. :thumbsup:
